column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the release and PR workflows generate their package tables
# from it, and run-emulator-tests.sh clears the local NuGet cache for every id listed here. Adding
# a package means adding a row here and a project under src/ - nothing else has a second copy of
# the list to fall out of step with.
# package-id

column1: MarketingCloudSDK.Net.Android
# NOT BOUND, and why.
# Salesforce publishes these under com.salesforce.marketingcloud on its GitHub-Pages Maven
# repository. This section doubles as the machine-read roster for the upstream-watch workflow -
# keep every entry a FULL artifact id.
#   pushfeaturemodule            Shipped INSIDE MarketingCloudSDK.Net.Android: the umbrella .pom's
#   pushmodelsmodule             modular artifacts. The feature/model modules are bound (public
#   inappmessagingfeaturemodule  API lives there since the v10 modularization); common and
#   inappmessagingmodelsmodule   legacy-crypto are payload-only wiring. Not missing; deliberately
#   common                       not packages of their own.
#   legacy-crypto
#   sfmcsdk                      The SFMC SDK core, bound by the sibling repository
#   common-internal              SFMCSDK.Net.Android, which this package depends on - mirroring
#                                how the native umbrella depends on sfmcsdk.
#   mobileappmessaging           Mobile App Messaging (MAM) - a separate, optional Salesforce
#   mobileappmessagingsdk        product on its own version line, not a dependency of the
#                                umbrella. A binding candidate once a consumer asks.
#   core                         2021-era leftovers of the pre-Unified architecture, last
#   version-safety-plugin        published years before this repository existed. Dead upstream.
